title: Pear and Ashoka diamond drop earrings, platinum
subtitle: A pear diamond moves differently than a round — its pointed tip traces an arc with every turn of the head. The Detachable Ashoka was designed to extend that motion: the Ashoka drop hangs below the pear stud on a locking bail that secures the connection but lets the stone swing freely. The motion is the point. The drop can be removed, leaving the pear alone. Two ways to wear the same diamonds.
